1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.

export function formatMoney(n, compact = false) {
  if (compact && Math.abs(n) >= 1_000_000) return `$${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(n >= 10_000_000 ? 0 : 1)}M`;
  if (compact && Math.abs(n) >= 10_000) return `$${(n / 1_000).toFixed(0)}K`;
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
    style: 'currency',
    currency: 'USD',
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(n);
}

export function familyById(id) {
  return FAMILIES.find((f) => f.id === id) || FAMILIES[0];

## Objective
- Build a complete playable 3D Sims-style mobile/tablet game with three selectable families (ultra-wealthy, rich, average/no connections), displayed money, preselected houses/clothes/jobs/businesses/cars/helicopters/planes/insurance, and vacations to 10 named cities with Economy/Business/First Class.

## Requirements
- 3D game optimized for phone/tablet with responsive layout, touch controls, and safe-area support.
- Three families: ultra wealthy, rich, average with no connections; money is displayed.
- Preselected per family: house, clothes, money, jobs, business, cars, helicopters, planes, insurances, other assets.
- Vacation cities exactly: Singapore, Tokyo, Los Angeles, Doha, Dubai, London, Paris, Milan, New York, Zurich.
- Cabin classes: Economy, Business, First Class.
- Build complete playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Save own checks as small JPEGs, viewport max 1280px; read only latest image.

## Decisions
- Built vanilla Vite + Three.js single-page game titled “HEIRLOOM — An Estate Life.”
- 3D estates generated procedurally from Three.js primitives; no external 3D models.
- Selection screen previews each 3D estate; then transitions into gameplay HUD.
- Game includes orbit/pinch camera, clickable family members, day/income loop, sunset moment action, family switching, assets/family/ledger/travel panels, flight sequence, 3D destination dioramas, and localStorage save/resume.
- Travel pricing is per household round trip, with class multipliers (economy 1×, business 2.8×, first 6.2×).
- Families: Vandermere (ultra, $84.5M available), Sato (rich, $2.18M), Bennett (average, $8,450, no connections).
- Installed bundled fonts and vendored Three.js through npm/Vite.
- Playwright Chromium 1243 was downloaded to match the CLI config.

## Work State
### Completed
- Vite project scaffold, package install, font downloads, static `index.html`.
- Full data model for 3 families, 10 destinations, 3 cabins.
- Procedural 3D estate builder for ultra/rich/average homes, pools, cars, helicopters, characters, landscaping.
- Procedural 3D flight stage and destination landmarks/dioramas.
- World manager with sky shader, lighting, camera tweens, orbit controls, raycasting, moods.
- Complete UI: selection, HUD, family/assets/ledger/travel panels, flight overlay, vacation overlay, switches, toasts, intro, day transitions, sound.
- Game logic: state per family, daily income, save/resume, trip booking/deduction, vacation bonuses, return home.
- Desktop screenshots verified selection and gameplay HUD; visuals/UI generally working.
- Pool water was fixed and is now visible/teal.
- Palm trees were rebuilt with better fronds.
- Helicopter orientation, basketball hoop placement, camera distance, shadow type adjusted.

### Active
- Visual QA after latest camera/asset tweaks; the last screenshot shows the stale selection screen because the “resume” click did not enter the game in the latest capture.
- Need verify family, assets, travel, flight, vacation, mobile portrait, and tablet layouts.

### Blocked
- None technically.

## Next Move
1. Reload and enter/resume game reliably via `#resume-btn` or `#enter-btn`, then capture the updated gameplay camera.
2. Verify Family and Assets panels visually at 1280×800.
3. Verify Travel panel, select a destination/cabin, book a trip, and capture flight + vacation screens.
4. Test mobile portrait at ~390×844 and tablet ~1024×768; fix responsive HUD/panel issues.
5. Test family switching, day advance, moment action, localStorage resume, insufficient-funds behavior for average family.
6. Improve remaining visual issues if time: richer ocean/horizon/clouds, empty interiors, car/helicopter detail, foreground palm appearance.
7. Run `npm run build` and final smoke test.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: game state, UI rendering, events, panels, travel flow, persistence.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/three/world.js`: renderer, camera, sky, lighting, stage switching, raycasting.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/three/estate.js`: all three 3D estates, props, characters, vehicles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/three/travel.js`: plane, clouds, city landmarks/destinations.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data.js`: family/destination/cabin data and formatting helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/style.css`: complete responsive UI styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/icons.js`: UI and city SVG icons.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: synthesized sound effects.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: app DOM skeleton.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/06-game.jpg`: last valid gameplay HUD capture before latest camera tweaks.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/07-family.jpg`: latest capture, still showing stale selection screen.
